title: Task 2.1: Advantages and Disadvantages of Pursuing a Career as a Sales Manager
content:
Read the following statement:

"In recent years, an increasing number of young graduates in developed countries like the United States prefer pursuing a career as a sales manager over other traditional professions. While this job offers high income potential and rapid career advancement, it also brings immense work pressure and irregular working hours."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of choosing a career as a sales manager. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was looking for a job with strong pay after university. Therefore, he decided to work as a sales manager for a retail company. As a result, he finally earned high commissions and became a team leader in two years. If he had not chosen this career, he would not have been able to grow his income so quickly.
body1.focus: Advantages of choosing a career as a sales manager
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, choosing a career as a sales manager brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make choosing a career as a sales manager appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that working as a sales manager offers high income potential through monthly bonuses. This means that young graduates can improve their living standard much faster than in many traditional jobs. Another point I would like to make is that this role provides practical experience in communication and teamwork. This is because of the fact that sales managers work with different clients every day, which helps them gain better career opportunities and fast promotion.

body2.example: For example, I was working in a small sales team during my internship. For this reason, I got to see my manager answering client phone calls late at night and missing family dinners. If I had not seen this daily pressure myself, I would not have been able to know that high-paying sales jobs can hurt a person's health.
body2.focus: Disadvantages of choosing a career as a sales manager
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of choosing a career as a sales manager are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that facing heavy sales targets and irregular working hours can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, sales managers often suffer from heavy workplace stress and irregular working hours. This happens because when bosses give tight monthly sales targets and employees worry about losing their jobs, it easily leads to working overtime, skipping meals, and feeling exhausted. In addition, meeting clients on evenings and weekends makes it very hard to reach a healthy balance between work and family time.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, choosing a career as a sales manager brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from earning high income and fast career growth, they also need to handle heavy sales targets and irregular working hours. Therefore, both individuals and companies should work together to make the most of a sales career responsibly.

title: Task 2.2: Advantages and Disadvantages of Becoming Famous
content:
Read the following statement:

"In today's media-saturated culture, many young people aspire to achieve fame and celebrity status. While being famous brings widespread recognition, lavish wealth, and exclusive privileges, it also entails heavy sacrifices."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of becoming famous. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was a talented local singer who wanted to support poor students in his hometown. Therefore, he decided to share his music online and join popular television contests. As a result, he finally became well known and raised money for a community school project. If he had not built public recognition, he would not have been able to help so many people.
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, becoming famous brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make becoming famous appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that fame brings high wealth and special privileges from sponsors and media shows. This means that famous people can improve their living standard quickly and enjoy comfortable lives. Another point I would like to make is that wide public recognition lets celebrities make a contribution to society. This is because of the fact that millions of fans listen to their voice, so they can easily support charity events and positive social messages.

body2.example: For example, I was watching a documentary about young pop stars who could not even walk in a park without masks and sunglasses. For this reason, I got to understand how tiring constant media attention can be. If I had not learned about their daily struggles, I would not have been able to know that fame requires such heavy personal sacrifices.
body2.focus: Disadvantages and heavy sacrifices of becoming famous
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of becoming famous are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that losing personal privacy and facing constant media pressure can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, celebrities often lose their personal privacy in crowded public venues and on social media. This happens because when reporters and fans follow their every move, it easily leads to harsh gossip, stress, and the inability to relax normally. In addition, constant pressure to stay popular makes famous people feel lonely and worried about making any small mistake.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, becoming famous brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from public recognition and high income, they also need to handle losing personal privacy and constant media pressure. Therefore, both individuals and media companies should work together to make the most of public fame responsibly.

title: Task 2.3: Fast Fashion: Root Causes and Environmental Solutions
content:
Read the following statement:

"The global fashion industry has witnessed the rapid expansion of 'fast fashion'—mass-producing cheap, low-quality garments to meet fleeting trends. However, this model now accounts for approximately 10% of total global carbon emissions and generates massive amounts of textile waste."

Write an essay to an educated reader analyzing the root causes of the fast fashion phenomenon and proposing viable solutions to mitigate its severe environmental damage. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, in many big cities today, young shoppers buy several cheap shirts during online sales every month and throw them away once a short trend ends. As a result, huge piles of clothing waste end up in landfills and cause serious carbon emissions.
body1.focus: Root causes of the fast fashion phenomenon
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, there are several major causes leading to the rapid growth of fast fashion | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these are the key causes of the rapid growth of fast fashion.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that modern consumers want cheap, trendy clothes to keep up with social media styles. This means that shopping apps tempt buyers to waste money on low-quality items that they only wear a few times. Another point I would like to make is that many clothing companies produce massive amounts of garments at low cost without caring about pollution. This is because of the fact that weak public awareness and the lack of strict rules allow factories to release waste easily.

body2.example: For example, many consumers now buy secondhand jackets and swap clothes with friends, while fashion stores offer small discounts when shoppers return old clothes for recycling. With steady effort from both sides, clothing waste can be reduced step by step.
body2.focus: Practical solutions to reduce fast fashion's environmental damage
body2.frame: Mở: In order to resolve such problems, both individuals and organizations should take practical measures | Ruột Solutions (Cá nhân + Tổ chức + Education)
body2.point: One primary solution would be that individuals should buy fewer clothes, choose durable items, and donate or recycle old garments instead of throwing them away. In addition, clothing companies and local authorities need to set fair environmental standards, encourage eco-friendly materials, and organize clothing recycling points. Above all, education plays a key role in tackling this issue, because people need to be aware of its impacts so that they can act responsibly.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, fast fashion is closely linked to cheap online shopping trends and weak public awareness and requires practical steps such as responsible buying habits and brand recycling programs. Therefore, both citizens and local authorities need to take steady, practical actions to reduce this problem in the long run.

title: Task 2.4: Computer Technology in Language Learning
content:
Read the following statement:

"In recent years, computer technology has become an essential part of foreign language education, offering interactive exercises, language apps, and instant access to online resources. However, some educators argue that overreliance on digital technology reduces genuine human interaction and speaking practice."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of computer technology in language learning. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was struggling with English listening and grammar before his university test. Therefore, he decided to use a free language app on his laptop for 30 minutes every evening. As a result, he finally improved his pronunciation and passed the exam easily. If he had not made the most of these online tools, he would not have been able to make such fast progress.
body1.focus: Advantages of computer technology in language learning
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, using computer technology in language learning brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make using computer technology in language learning appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that computer tools and language apps are a fast, convenient way to study anytime and anywhere. This means that learners can practice English speaking daily and receive instant feedback on their grammar errors. Another point I would like to make is that digital technology makes self-study much more affordable for everyone. This is because of the fact that students can access free videos, dictionaries, and interactive exercises online instead of paying for expensive private tutors.

body2.example: For example, I was studying vocabulary only through laptop exercises for six months. For this reason, I got to feel very nervous and forgot simple words when I first spoke to a foreign tourist in person. If I had not experienced that awkward conversation, I would not have been able to know that real human practice is still necessary.
body2.focus: Disadvantages of computer technology in language learning
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of using computer technology in language learning are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that losing face-to-face speaking practice can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, relying too much on computers gives students fewer opportunities for real face-to-face interaction with teachers and classmates. This happens because when learners only tap answers on a screen instead of talking to real people, it easily leads to shyness and weak communication skills in real life. In addition, studying on connected devices can make students lose concentration when social media notifications pop up.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, using computer technology in language learning brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from flexible and affordable online study tools, they also need to handle losing face-to-face speaking practice. Therefore, both individuals and schools should work together to make the most of computer technology responsibly.

intro.ld2: losing face-to-face speaking practice and relying too much on screens

title: Task 2.5: Advantages and Disadvantages of Riding Motorbikes in Cities
content:
Read the following statement:

"In many busy cities, motorbikes continue to be a convenient and affordable means of transportation for daily commuters. However, the heavy use of motorbikes also raises serious concerns regarding traffic accidents, noise, and urban air pollution."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of riding motorbikes in cities. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

As a result, he finally cut his travel time in half and saved extra money each month. If he had not switched to a motorbike, he would not have been able to manage his busy schedule so easily.
body1.focus: Advantages of riding motorbikes in cities
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, riding motorbikes in busy cities brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make riding motorbikes in busy cities appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that motorbikes are a fast, convenient way for busy commuters to move around crowded cities. This means that riders can easily pass through narrow streets and reach work or school on time. Another point I would like to make is that owning a motorbike fits comfortably within most families' budgets. This is because of the fact that motorbikes cost much less to buy, fuel, and park than cars.

body2.example: For example, many residents in big Asian cities often face thick exhaust smoke and loud engine noise every morning on their way to work. If this issue is ignored, it will cause worse air pollution and serious breathing problems for city residents.
body2.focus: Disadvantages of riding motorbikes in cities
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of riding motorbikes in busy cities are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that traffic accidents, loud noise, and urban air pollution can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, heavy motorbike use leads to frequent traffic accidents and constant street noise. This happens because when thousands of riders crowd narrow roads during rush hour without following traffic rules, it easily leads to dangerous crashes and daily stress. In addition, traditional gasoline motorbikes release harmful exhaust fumes that damage the environment and harm citizens' health.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, riding motorbikes in cities brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from fast and affordable daily travel, they also need to handle traffic accidents, noise, and urban air pollution. Therefore, both individuals and local authorities should work together to make the most of city transport responsibly.
